pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Channo anācāraṃ ācarati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.7: kiṃ nu kho nāma tumhe āvuso maṃ vattabbaṃ maññatha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.11: seyyathāpi nāma mahāvāto vāyanto tiṇakaṭṭhapaṇṇakasaṭaṃ ekato ussāreyya, seyyathā vā pana nadī pabbateyyā saṅkhasevālapaṇakaṃ ekato ussāreyya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.12: evam eva tumhe nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā ekato ussāritā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.13: kiṃ nu kho nāma tumhe āvuso maṃ vattabbaṃ maññatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.17: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.18: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Channo bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.19: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.20: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Channa bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karosīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.23: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.24: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.25: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.26.1: bhikkhu pan' eva dubbacajātiko hoti, uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.27: mā maṃ āyasmanto kiñci avacuttha kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, ahaṃ p' āyasmante na kiñci vakkhāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.29: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.30: māyasmā attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ akāsi, vacanīyaṃ eva āyasmā attānaṃ karotu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.31: āyasmāpi bhikkhū vadetu saha dhammena, bhikkhū pi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti saha dhammena,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.32: evaṃ saṃvaddhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā yad idaṃ aññamaññavacanena aññamaññavuṭṭhāpanenā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.33: evañ ca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tath' eva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.34: yāvatatiyañ ce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.2: dubbaco hoti dovacassa karaṇehi dhammehi samannāgato akkhamo appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.8: yaṃ bhagavatā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ etaṃ sahadhammikaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.10: mā maṃ āyasmanto kiñci avacuttha kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, ahaṃ p' āyasmante na kiñci vakkhāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, viramathāyasmanto mama vacanāyā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.14: aññehi bhikkhūhi ye passanti ye suṇanti, tehi vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.17: āyasmāpi bhikkhū vadetu saha dhammena, bhikkhū pi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti saha dhammena,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.18: evaṃ saṃvaddhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā yad idaṃ aññamaññavacanena aññamaññavuṭṭhāpanenā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.24: so bhikkhu saṃghamajjham pi ākaḍḍhitvā vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.35: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.37: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.59: saṃghādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjantassa ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ dvīhi kammavācāhi thullaccayā paṭippassambhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:3.1.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajjati, āpatti saṃghādisesassa.
